newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville offers only off-peak power for Friday.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville offers only off-peak power for Friday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) again pulled out of the next-day market for power during daytime hours, offering only off-peak power for Friday, the agency said Thursday.
Friday prices for non-firm power for hours ending at 0600 PDT and 2300 PDT were unchanged at $9.50 for all deliveries, while prices for hours ending 0100-0500 PDT and 2400 PDT were steady at $9.00.
Firm power during off-peak hours on Friday was also unchanged at $9.00 per MWh.
